opencode-team-leadThe AI team lead for OpenCode

Plans, delegates, reviews, and synthesizes — so your AI agents actually work as a team.

Get Started
View on GitHub
🎯

Pure Delegation

The team-lead never touches code directly. Every task goes to a specialized agent. Clean separation, zero context contamination.

🔍

Multi-agent Reviews

The review-manager spawns specialized reviewers in parallel — code quality, security, requirements. Verdicts are synthesized automatically.

🐛

Structured Investigation

The bug-finder forces root-cause analysis before any fix. No more workarounds that mask symptoms and create code divergence.

🔒

Pattern Enforcement

Harness encodes recurring patterns as lint rules, CI checks, and AGENTS.md entries. Prevention beats repetition.

📋

Context-aware Planning

The planning agent writes exec-plans to disk. Multi-session work survives context resets — the team-lead resumes exactly where it left off.

⚡

Zero Dependencies

Pure ESM, only Node.js builtins. Installs in seconds, no supply chain risk. Ships with provenance attestation.

Are you an LLM? View /opencode-team-lead/llms.txt for optimized Markdown documentation, or /opencode-team-lead/llms-full.txt for full documentation bundle

Quick Install ​

Add to your opencode.json:

json
{
  "plugin": ["opencode-team-lead"]
}
1
2
3

OpenCode will automatically download and load the plugin on next startup. All 11 agents are registered automatically — no npm install needed.

Set team-lead as your default agent

json
{
  "plugin": ["opencode-team-lead"],
  "default_agent": "team-lead"
}
